function_question: How does nature fall slowly and ride the wind?

opening.text: There was a girl called Priya whose best friend Sam had a treehouse high above Priya's garden.
Sam and Priya sent notes up and down between the treehouse and the garden, full of jokes, plans and secret codes.
Sam's paper note blew right over the fence, and the next one, weighed down, dropped straight into the flowerbed. Priya called up: "We need a better way!"

card.problem: Notes blow away or crash down
card.goal: A slow flyer that lands on target

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: The lost messages
chapters.line: One note flies away, one drops like a stone. Priya looks up at the treehouse and thinks.

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Priya asks for help
chapters.line: Priya needs a teammate on the ground. What about you?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The sky riders
chapters.line: You and Priya meet seeds and animals that drift, spin and glide.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of falling slowly
chapters.line: The sky riders share the secret they all use.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Training in the drop lab
chapters.line: Priya grabs three sheets of paper and a stopwatch.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The idea storm
chapters.line: Twenty ideas in five minutes, and then you pick a winner!

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The plan
chapters.line: Every great flyer starts as a drawing.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big test
chapters.line: The first flyer drops too fast. You change one thing, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Special delivery!
chapters.line: The message spins down slowly and lands right by Priya's feet.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Priya and Sam's notes keep blowing away or crashing down. Can you help them send messages safely? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature solved this millions of years ago. Tap each card to meet four nature heroes who ride the wind!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which paper shape will take the longest to fall?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your flyer like a real engineer!
guide.build_and_test: Build your flyer and let's see how slowly it carries Priya's message down!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE thing and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, notes spin gently down from the treehouse on YOUR flyer, and Priya catches every one!

quick_check.question: The message must land within 1 m of the target. Priya's lands 80 cm away. Is it a hit?
quick_check.right: Yes! 1 m is 100 cm, and 80 cm is less than that. A hit means Priya can catch it without chasing it!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Remember 1 m = 100 cm. Is 80 cm more or less than that?

clue_cards.name: Maple seed
clue_cards.trick: One heavy seed with a single thin wing.
clue_cards.does: It spins like a helicopter blade as it falls, which can more than double its fall time.

clue_cards.name: Dandelion seed
clue_cards.trick: A crown of about 100 fine hairs.
clue_cards.does: Air flows through the gaps and swirls above it, so it can drift for kilometres.

clue_cards.name: Flying squirrel
clue_cards.trick: A flap of skin stretched between its front and back legs.
clue_cards.does: It glides more than 50 m from one tree to the next.

clue_cards.name: Javan cucumber seed
clue_cards.does: It glides like a tiny aircraft, and it inspired early glider designs.

predict.prompt: Fast or slow? Predict how each one falls from the same height!
predict.explain: A clip or a tight ball pushes very little air out of the way, so it drops fast. A spinning wing keeps meeting new air, so drag slows it down.

lab.title: The paper drop lab
lab.predict: Which paper shape will take the longest to fall?

tool.name: Brainstorm
tool.intro: A brainstorm is a storm of ideas: first you make lots, then you choose. You already know the first 3 rules. Today you'll learn the last 2.

parts.name: Build on ideas
parts.what: Take an idea and add to it to make it better.
parts.example: 💧 "A bottle with a strap" + "a clip" = it hooks onto your bag.
parts.starter: Sam's idea was a parachute. I can build on it by…

parts.name: Pick the best
parts.what: Choose the idea that fits the goal best.
parts.example: 💧 Out of 20 bottle ideas, pick the one that never spills.
parts.starter: I sort my ideas into fast, slow and floating. The best slow one is…
